noOrdersToday: No takeaway order for this day.
pickAnOrder: Pick an order to see the details.
stoppedHint: No new orders until it reopens.
checkConnection: Check the connection and try again.

card.title: Takeaway
card.subtitle: Capacity per slot, prep minutes and stop
card.loadFailed: Settings not loaded: reopen the card to try again.
card.readOnly: Read only: it needs the «Manages takeaway orders» permission.
card.onlineHint: The public /ordina page: switched off it shows the maintenance card with the contacts.
card.switchOnWhenReady: Switch it on when the kitchen is ready to take orders from the site.
card.byPhoneHint: Sofia takes takeaway orders on the phone, with the same slot and capacity rules.
card.voiceOn: Sofia offers and records the orders for pickup.
card.voiceOff: Off: on the phone Sofia invites them to order in person or from the site.
card.boardDayHint: The day navigator is in the header, as in Reservations and Floor. Here you decide whether it moves the other pages too, or only the takeaway.
card.dayGlobalHint: The day is the app's: changing it here changes it in reservations, floor and till too.
card.dayOwnHint: The counter keeps its own day: changing it does not touch the other pages.
card.perSlotHint: How many orders the kitchen takes in one pickup slot. The counter can force it anyway.
card.prepMinutesHint: How long before pickup an order becomes «To make».
card.stopHint: Stops new orders for one date only: it lapses by itself the day after.
